name: Notice to Advertiser of Sign Repair / Removal
description: Notice to the advertiser when signage needs repair or removal, requesting action within 72 hours.
deadline: request repair / removal within seventy-two (72) hours of notification
quote: In the event the District becomes aware of a sign or other advertising/promotional materials requiring repair or removal, the District shall notify the responsible individual or organization and request repair/removal within seventy-two (72) hours of notification.
